title: Fee Schedule Footnote: Repeat Returns on a Design Studio Selections File
content:
A returned payment fee on a Design Studio Selections file is multiplied by a repeat-return multiple set by the option deposit payments returned unpaid on the file in the last 12 months, the return being charged included:

| Option deposit payments returned on the file in the last 12 months | Repeat-return multiple |
|---|---|
| Three or more | 2 |
| Exactly two | 1.5 |
| A single one (the return being charged) | 1 |

*Records read:* the returned-payment entries on the file's design ledger dated within the last 12 months.

*Hypothetical case:* a payment returned today, after another returned five months ago and a third returned thirteen months ago, makes two returns in the last 12 months: multiple 1.5.
